items.colloc: apportion funds 撥款 | apportion blame 分擔責任
items.distinct: distribute 散佈 | allot 指派工作
ex: The finance committee must apportion the funds fairly among departments.
財務委員會必須在各部門之間公平地分配資金。
We need to apportion the remaining budget for the next quarter.
我們需要為下一季分配剩餘的預算。
The costs were apportioned based on the usage of each team.
費用是根據每個團隊的使用情況進行分攤的。

items.colloc: budget appropriation 預算撥款 | annual appropriation 年度撥款
items.distinct: grant 補助金 | subsidy 津貼
ex: The legislative body approved a massive appropriation for infrastructure projects.
立法機關批准了一項用於基礎設施建設的巨額撥款。
Management requested an emergency appropriation to cover the repair costs.
管理層要求緊急撥款以支付維修費用。
The total appropriation for research and development has been increased.
研發的總撥款金額已經有所增加。

items.pos: n. 意外事故；應急準備
items.colloc: contingency plan 應變計畫 | contingency fund 準備金
items.distinct: emergency 緊急狀況 | provision 條款
ex: We have set aside ten percent of the budget for contingency.
我們已經預留了預算的百分之十作為應急準備金。
A contingency plan is essential for any large-scale financial project.
對於任何大型財務專案，應變計畫都是必不可少的。
The project costs increased due to an unforeseen contingency last month.
由於上個月發生不可預見的意外，專案成本增加了。

items.colloc: curtail spending 縮減開支 | curtail production 減產
items.distinct: reduce 減少 | terminate 終止
ex: The company had to curtail its travel expenses this fiscal year.
公司在本財政年度不得不縮減差旅支出。
Rising operational costs forced the firm to curtail some non-essential services.
營運成本上升迫使公司縮減了一些非必要的服務。
We must curtail our marketing budget until our revenue stabilizes.
在營收穩定之前，我們必須削減行銷預算。

items.pos: adj. 自由裁量的；自主支配的
items.colloc: discretionary income 可支配所得 | discretionary spending 自主性支出
items.distinct: mandatory 強制性的 | arbitrary 隨意的
ex: The manager has a small discretionary fund for office improvements.
經理擁有一小筆可用於辦公室改善的自由支配資金。
Families often cut back on discretionary spending during an economic downturn.
經濟低迷時期，家庭通常會削減自主性支出。
Discretionary bonuses will be awarded based on individual performance reviews.
自主性獎金將根據個人績效評估結果發放。

items.pos: v. 指定用途；預留 | n. 特徵
items.colloc: earmark for 被指定用於 | earmark funds 撥專款
items.distinct: reserve 保留 | designate 指定職位
ex: The government decided to earmark more money for renewable energy.
政府決定撥出更多資金用於再生能源。
These profits are earmarked for the construction of a new factory.
這些利潤已被指定用於建設新工廠。
They will earmark a portion of the grant for staff training.
他們將撥出一部分補助金用於員工培訓。

items.colloc: frugal lifestyle 節儉的生活 | frugal management 節約管理
items.distinct: economical 經濟實惠的 | stingy 吝嗇的
ex: The startup maintained a frugal approach to survive the first year.
這家新創公司保持節儉的方式以度過第一年。
Our CEO is known for being frugal with the company resources.
我們的執行長以對公司資源的節省而聞名。
A frugal budget allowed the small business to remain debt-free.
節約的預算使這家小企業能夠保持無債務狀態。

items.colloc: annual increment 年度加薪 | salary increment 調薪
items.distinct: increase 增加 | expansion 擴張
ex: Employees can expect a five percent salary increment every January.
員工可以預期每年一月有百分之五的薪資調升。
The budget will be released in small increments over six months.
預算將在六個月內以小額增量的形式分批發放。
The system automatically calculates the tax increment based on your earnings.
系統會根據你的收入自動計算稅收增額。

items.colloc: budget justification 預算說明 | provide justification 提供理由
items.distinct: reason 理由 | validation 驗證
ex: The department head provided a detailed justification for the additional staff.
部門主管為增聘員工提供了詳細的正當理由。
Without proper justification, the board will not approve the expensive equipment.
若無適當理由，董事會將不會批准購買昂貴設備。
The memo serves as a justification for the recent price increase.
這份備忘錄是作為最近價格調漲的說明文件。

items.colloc: budgetary oversight 預算監督 | through an oversight 由於疏忽
items.distinct: supervision 監理 | negligence 怠忽職守
ex: The committee is responsible for the financial oversight of the project.
該委員會負責該專案的財務監督。
The payment was missed due to a clerical oversight in accounting.
由於會計部門的文書疏忽，導致漏掉了該筆付款。
Strict oversight is required to ensure the funds are used correctly.
需要嚴格監督以確保資金被正確使用。

items.colloc: prudent investment 審慎投資 | prudent financial management 穩健理財
items.distinct: cautious 小心的 | wise 聰明的
ex: A prudent investor always considers the potential risks before committing capital.
審慎的投資者在投入資金前總是會考慮潛在風險。
The board made a prudent decision to postpone the expansion project.
董事會做出了延後擴張計畫的明智決定。
Maintaining a cash reserve is a prudent practice for small businesses.
保持現金儲備對小企業來說是穩健的做法。

items.colloc: compulsory redundancy 強制裁員 | redundancy pay 遣散費
items.distinct: surplus 過剩 | dismissal 解雇
ex: The merger led to several redundancies in the administrative department.
此次合併導致行政部門出現了數個裁員名額。
Automating the process has eliminated the need for data entry redundancy.
流程自動化消除了解決數據輸入冗餘的需求。
The company offered voluntary redundancy packages to senior staff members.
公司向資深員工提供了自願遣散方案。

items.colloc: budget shortfall 預算短缺 | revenue shortfall 收入不足
items.distinct: deficit 赤字 | shortage 短缺
ex: The unexpected legal fees caused a significant shortfall in our annual budget.
意外的法律費用導致我們的年度預算出現重大短缺。
We need to find alternative funding to cover the budget shortfall.
我們需要尋找替代資金來彌補預算缺口。
A shortfall in production led to a decrease in quarterly sales.
生產不足導致了季度銷售額的下降。

items.colloc: stipulate conditions 規定條件 | as stipulated in the contract 如合同規定
items.distinct: specify 詳述 | require 要求
ex: The agreement stipulates that all expenses must be approved in advance.
協議規定所有支出都必須事先獲得批准。
The contract stipulates a penalty for any delays in the delivery.
合約中規定了任何交貨延遲的罰則。
International laws stipulate how these specific funds should be managed.
國際法律規定了這些特定資金應如何管理。

items.colloc: stringent requirements 嚴格要求 | stringent budget 嚴格的預算
items.distinct: strict 嚴厲的 | rigorous 嚴密的
ex: The project must comply with stringent safety regulations set by the city.
該專案必須遵守城市設定的嚴格安全法規。
A stringent budget policy was implemented to control the company expenses.
為了控制公司開支，執行了嚴格的預算政策。
Candidates must meet the stringent criteria to qualify for the scholarship.
候選人必須符合嚴格的標準才有資格獲得獎學金。

items.colloc: budget variance 預算差異 | at variance with 與...不符
items.distinct: difference 不同 | deviation 偏差
ex: The manager explained the reasons for the variance between actual and estimated costs.
經理說明了實際成本與預估成本之間產生差異的原因。
We need to analyze the monthly variance in our utility expenses.
我們需要分析每月水電費支出的變動情況。
Any significant variance in the financial report must be investigated immediately.
財務報告中的任何重大差異都必須立即調查。

items.colloc: economic viability 經濟可行性 | long-term viability 長期生存能力
items.distinct: feasibility 可行性 | capability 能力
ex: The investors are questioning the long-term viability of the current business model.
投資者正在質疑目前商業模式的長期可行性。
A thorough market study is required to assess the commercial viability.
需要進行深入的市場研究以評估其商業可行性。
The government is concerned about the financial viability of the public project.
政府擔心該公共工程在財務上的可行性。
